scientific_question: Does a learned compositional meaning-to-language mechanism preserve requested facts and produce useful human-like text on categories not observed during training, at a competitive total resource cost, rather than merely memorizing domain-specific E2E patterns?

prior_boundary.result: Bounded positive: frozen L7 constrained realizer used TRAIN-learned human-language patterns on 160/160 fresh E2E public DEV MRs with 700/704 five-field literal hits and no canonical fallback.
unresolved: literal copy is not semantic entailment
single-reference token F1 is not fluency
no matched strong recurrent/transformer resource comparison

rules: Resolve full Git commit identities from metadata before reading corpus bytes.
Verify the release_v3.0 tree ancestry contains the required a7ea49b5 prefix uniquely.
Commit an exact source-manifest follow-up before any training/dev XML or JSON is parsed.
Official WebNLG test data is protected and MUST NOT be fetched, parsed, scored, copied, or used for model selection in L9.
Raw corpus text and XML/JSON are not committed as repository files or workflow artifacts.

frozen_split_rule.category_partition: For each category C, compute SHA256(UTF8(lowercase(trim(C)))); first digest byte modulo 4 == 0 => L9_AUDIT_CATEGORY, otherwise L9_TRAIN_CATEGORY. No category may cross partitions.
frozen_split_rule.train_selection_within_training_categori: Use only official TRAIN examples in L9_TRAIN_CATEGORY categories. Canonical example identity SHA256 determines role: digest first byte modulo 5 == 0 => L9_SELECT, otherwise L9_TRAIN.
frozen_split_rule.audit: Use only official DEV examples in L9_AUDIT_CATEGORY categories. All are L9_AUDIT_DEV. Do not tune on them.
frozen_split_rule.fail_closed: If deterministic partition does not meet all minimums, stop and revise only through a new protocol version before any model fitting.

semantic_input.representation: Ordered canonical RDF triple set with normalized subject, predicate, object strings; retain original triple identity and reference grouping.
semantic_input.canonicalization: Sort triples by normalized subject,predicate,object only for hashing/accounting; models receive a deterministic serialization with explicit triple boundaries.
forbidden_shortcuts: hidden answers in IDs, filenames or route labels
